sizeConverter.title: Shoe, Clothing & Ring Size Converter
sizeConverter.subtitle: Pick a Korean mm or size and see US, UK, EU and JP sizes at once. Enter a measured foot length or finger circumference to get the size that fits.

unisex.m: On unisex labels this is M {m} / W {w}. Women buying a unisex model can use this.
unisex.w: For a unisex (men's sizing) model, this foot length is M {m} / W {w}. Unisex labels put the women's US half a size higher than women-only models.

m: Korean mm is foot length. US, UK and EU on the same row are the values Nike and adidas public charts share.
UK and EU differ by about 0.5 between brands. adidas labels 270mm as UK 8.5 · EU 42⅔.
JP is in cm, so it equals Korean mm ÷ 10.
w: At the same foot length, women's US is 1 higher than men's (250mm = men 7 · women 8).
UK varies by 0.5 between brands. Nike's women's chart is 0.5 lower, adidas 0.5 higher.
JP is in cm, so it equals Korean mm ÷ 10.
k: Kids' sizes are based on foot length (mm). 1Y follows 13.5C, and Y sizes use the same numbers as US men's.
UK kids' sizes carry a K. UK adult 1 follows 13.5K.
The cm printed on Nike boxes is smaller than foot length, so it may differ from the mm here.
mt: Korean sizes (95, 100) are chest circumference in cm. US brands usually run a size larger, so Korean 100 is close to US M.
EU numbers follow suits and jackets and are about half the chest circumference.
Shoulder width and length vary by brand, so check the product's measurement chart too.
wt: 44, 55 and 66 are old labels set in 1981 (55 = 155cm tall, 85cm bust). Today's brands are often roomier under the same label.
EU uses French sizing. German sizes are 2 smaller and Italian sizes 4 larger.
JP numbers are a common industry match. Japanese clothing runs small, so Korean 55 is close to Japanese 9 (M).
pt: Korean pants labels (28, 30, …) are waist inches. 1 inch = 2.54cm.
Labels refer to body waist, so the garment's flat waist may differ. Compare the product's half-waist × 2.
Dress pants are sometimes labeled in cm such as 76, 79, 82. Find the nearest row in the waist (cm) column.
r: Korean ring sizes follow the same scale as Japanese sizes (common industry chart). Size 1 is 13.0mm across and each size adds 1/3mm.
US is rounded to 0.5. When one US label spans two Korean sizes, the closer one is chosen.
UK uses British Standard (BS 6820) letters; EU/ISO is inner circumference in mm.

warn.shoe: Sizes can differ by 0.5–1 between brands and models. Always check the brand's own size chart on the product page before buying.
warn.cloth: Clothing sizes vary widely by brand and fit. This is a rough industry mapping, so compare the product's measurements (chest width, length) as well.
warn.ring: This is the ring size chart commonly used by Korean retailers. Brands may differ slightly, so double-check with the inner diameter of a ring you own.

shoe.label: Measured foot length (optional)
shoe.hint: Enter the length from heel to the tip of your longest toe (mm) to get a matching size.
shoe.tip: This is the closest size not smaller than your measurement. With wide feet, thick socks or running shoes, also try 5mm larger.

chest.label: Measured chest (optional)
chest.hint: Enter the body circumference (cm) measured level around the fullest part just under the armpits.
chest.tip: This is based on body measurements. Go one size up for a relaxed fit.

waist.label: Measured waist (optional)
waist.hint: Enter your waist circumference (cm) where you wear your pants.
waist.tip: This is the closest inch size not smaller than your waist.

finger.label: Measured finger circumference (optional)
finger.hint: Wrap a thin paper strip or dental floss where the ring sits and enter the length (mm).
finger.tip: Between two sizes, the larger one is chosen. If your knuckle is large, consider one size up.

measure.high: Larger than this chart. Check the brand's extended size chart.
measure.low: Smaller than this chart. Check the unit (mm or cm) or try another type such as kids.

table.title: {tab} full conversion chart
table.hint: The selected row is highlighted. Tap the first cell to switch to that row. Swipe sideways if the chart is wide.
table.caption: {tab} size conversion chart

basis.m: Basis: US men = (mm − 180) ÷ 10, UK = US − 1, EU = adidas-style 1/3 steps rounded down to 0.5. Compared against Nike and adidas public charts.
basis.w: Basis: US women = (mm − 170) ÷ 10, UK = (mm − 190) ÷ 10, EU uses the same mm conversion as men. Compared against Nike and adidas public charts.
basis.k: Basis: US kids size ≈ 3 × foot length (in) − 9.75, UK = US − 0.5, EU ≈ 1.5 × foot length (cm) + 2.
basis.mt: Basis: Korean size = chest circumference (cm). US and EU are common industry matches.
basis.wt: Basis: bust from the 1981 labels (44 = 82cm, 3cm steps). 77 and 88 follow the same step. US, UK, EU and JP are common industry matches.
basis.r: Basis: inner diameter = 13.0 + (size − 1) ÷ 3 mm, circumference = diameter × π. US diameter = 11.63 + 0.8128 × size; UK letters start at C = 40mm and add 1.25mm each.

tips.title: Before you order from overseas
tips.duty: Korean customs exempts goods worth up to ${us} shipped from the US under list clearance, or ${other} from elsewhere (goods price, excluding international shipping). Above that, shoes and clothing pay {rate}% duty plus 10% VAT.
items: Overseas returns and exchanges often mean paying international shipping yourself, which can exceed the item price. Check whether returns are free and whether they work through a forwarding address.
Items split across orders from the same seller on the same day may be combined for the duty-free limit.
If you're unsure, read the product's measurement chart and reviews that say 'true to size' or 'runs small' first.

measureShoe.title: How to measure your foot
items: Measure in the evening, when feet are largest.
Stand with your heel against a wall, weight on the foot, mark the tip of the longest toe on paper and measure to the wall.
Measure both feet and use the larger one.
Korean shoe labels (mm) are foot length. The inside of a shoe is usually 1.3–1.7cm longer than the foot, so picking your measured size still leaves room.

between.title: When you're between sizes
items: Between two sizes, go with the larger one. Nike's size guide says the same.
Feet swell and slide forward in running and hiking shoes, so many people go 5mm larger.
With wide feet, look for a wide (e.g. 2E) model first. Sizing up in length leaves the toe loose.
If a shoe from the same brand already fits, its US or UK label is the most reliable guide.

kids.title: Kids' C and Y sizes
items: C is for little children and Y (youth) for bigger kids. 1Y comes after 13.5C.
Y sizes use the same numbers as US men's. 7Y = men's 7, so adults with small feet sometimes wear Y (GS) sizes.
Kids' feet grow fast, but shoes that are too big make walking awkward and falls more likely. Pick a size not smaller than the measurement.
The same C number can mean slightly different foot lengths across brands. Compare by foot length (mm) in the chart.

cloth.title: Choosing clothing sizes
items: Korean men's top numbers (95, 100, 105) are chest circumference in cm; women's 44, 55, 66 are old labels.
US clothing often runs a size larger under the same letter. Korean L (100) is close to US M.
European numbers differ by country. The same garment is French 38 = German 36 = Italian 42.
Most accurate: measure the chest width and length of clothes that fit you and compare with the product's measurement chart.

ring.title: How to measure ring size
items: Wrap a thin paper strip or dental floss once where the ring sits, mark the overlap and measure the length (mm). Thick string reads larger.
Fingers swell in the evening and in warm weather. Measure morning and evening and compare.
If your knuckle is large, measure it too to make sure the ring can pass over it.
If you have a ring that fits, measure its inner diameter with a ruler and use the 'inner diameter' system for the most accurate result.

items.q: What US size is a 270mm shoe?
items.a: For men it's US 9, UK 8, EU 42.5. Nike and adidas both label 270mm as US 9, but UK and EU differ by about 0.5 by brand, for example adidas uses UK 8.5 · EU 42⅔.

items.q: How different are women's and men's US sizes?
items.a: At the same foot length (mm), women's US is 1 higher than men's (250mm = men 7 · women 8). Unisex labels usually write women's = men's + 1.5 (M 7 / W 8.5). For unisex models, choosing by men's size is less confusing.

items.q: What's the difference between kids' C and Y sizes?
items.a: C covers little children and Y bigger kids. 1Y follows 13.5C, and 7Y has the same number as US men's 7. 10C is about 167mm of foot length.

items.q: Why does this differ by 0.5–1 size from other charts?
items.a: There is no single agreed formula between national shoe sizes. Nike labels 270mm as UK 8 and adidas as UK 8.5, and the ISO formula adds an allowance to foot length and gives yet another value. This tool uses the values major brand charts share, so make the final choice with the chart of the brand you're buying.

items.q: What are women's 55 and 66 in US and European sizes?
items.a: The industry usually matches 55 = S · US 4 · UK 8 · EU 36 and 66 = M · US 6 · UK 10 · EU 38. 55 and 66 are old labels from 1981 (55 = 155cm tall, 85cm bust), so they differ a lot from today's brands. Comparing by measured bust is more accurate.

items.q: How do I find my ring size?
items.a: Measure your finger circumference (mm) with a thin paper strip and enter it; the tool suggests the size whose inner circumference is not smaller. A 52mm finger is size 12 (52.4mm inner circumference). Between two sizes, choose the larger.

items.q: Ring charts show different circumferences. Which is right?
items.a: This tool uses the ring's inner circumference (diameter × π), so size 9 = 15.7mm across · 49.2mm around. Some charts list finger circumference about 3mm larger, such as size 1 = 44mm, which shifts results by about 3 sizes. Measuring the inner diameter of a ring you own is the surest check.
